title: Radiation pressure expression
description: Essential: Correctly derives P = L⊙/(4πR²c) from intensity and radiation pressure relationship.

title: Force ratio derivation
description: Important: Correctly computes F_radiation/F_gravity ratio with proper mass substitution and simplification.

title: Orbital velocity formula
description: Essential: States v = √(GM⊙/R) from centripetal-gravitational force balance.

title: Torque from aberration
description: Important: Derives τ = -R·F_tan with F_tan proportional to v/c from radiation aberration.

title: Differential equation setup
description: Important: Connects τ = dL/dt to dR/dt using quasi-circular orbit assumption and angular momentum expression.

title: Numerical time calculation
description: Essential: Computes final removal time ≈ 2×10¹⁴ s with correct unit conversion and substitution.

title: Missing factor Q
description: Pitfall: Omits quality factor Q in radiation pressure, force ratio, or torque expressions.

title: Sign error in torque
description: Pitfall: Fails to include negative sign indicating torque reduces angular momentum.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Verifies dimensional consistency in derived expressions, especially in differential equation.

title: Aberration justification
description: Optional: Explains why v ≪ c allows small-angle approximation for tangential force component.
